newsitem.title: KENYA: Coffee prices firmer at Kenyan auction.
newsitem.headline: Coffee prices firmer at Kenyan auction.

text.p: Coffee prices were much firmer at the weekly export auction on Tuesday, rising by $5-10, traders said.
Grade AAs averaged $138.5 per 50-kg bag from $131.5 last week, grade ABs rose to $134.5 from $125.5 while Cs rose to $127 from $118.5. The market's average rose to $119.25 from $111.00 last week.

"With reduced quantity on offer, short covering pushed prices up by $5-10," the auction official told Reuters. The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 28,625 60-kg bags of coffee offered for sale compared to 33,060 bags last week.
